mapper.sql: v . id ,v.activity_id activityId,v.user_id userId, v.ctime, v.type, v.status, v.like_count likeCount, v.view_count viewCount, v.comment_count commentCount
mapper.select:
select
from corgi_vlog v left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = v.user_id where v.ctime <=#{ctime} and v.user_id != #{userId}
and d.group in (select `group` from user_prefer_group where user_id = #{userId})
order by like_count desc limit 20

select
from corgi_vlog_hot h left join corgi_vlog v on h.activity_id = v.activity_id where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{userId} and h.activity_id = f.feed) and h.expect_view > h.view_count and h.status = 'open' and h.type = 'auto' order by h.like_count desc limit #{size}

select
from corgi_vlog_hot h left join corgi_vlog v on h.activity_id = v.activity_id where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{vlog.userId} and h.activity_id = f.feed) and h.expect_view > h.view_count and h.status = 'open' and h.type = #{vlog.type} order by h.like_count limit #{size}
